writing.title: Children's daily screen time by device
writing.prompt:
The line graph below shows the average number of hours per day that children aged 8 to 12 in one country spent using three types of screen between 2012 and 2024.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.
outline: Mở bài: paraphrase (số giờ mỗi ngày trẻ 8–12 tuổi dùng 3 loại màn hình, 2012–2024)
Tổng quan: điện thoại/máy tính bảng thay TV thành loại phổ biến nhất; máy chơi game gần như ổn định
Thân 1: TV giảm đều 2.4 → 1.1 giờ; điện thoại/tablet tăng mạnh 0.5 → 3.1 giờ, vượt TV khoảng năm 2017
Thân 2: máy chơi game dao động nhẹ 1.0–1.3 giờ, cuối kỳ 1.1 giờ – bằng TV
vocab: nhiều nhất, bỏ xa phần còn lại
Television was by far the most common screen in 2012.
Time on games consoles remained fairly stable.
The final figure was six times the initial figure.
writing.sample:
The line graph illustrates how many hours a day children aged between 8 and 12 in one country spent on television, smartphones or tablets, and games consoles from 2012 to 2024.

Overall, smartphones and tablets replaced television as the most popular type of screen during the period, while the time spent on games consoles remained fairly stable.

In 2012, television was by far the most common form of screen entertainment, with children watching it for an average of 2.4 hours a day. This figure then fell steadily, reaching just 1.1 hours by 2024. In contrast, the use of smartphones and tablets rose dramatically from only half an hour a day at the beginning of the period. It overtook television at some point between 2015 and 2018 and continued to climb, reaching 2.9 hours in 2021 and 3.1 hours in 2024, more than six times the initial figure.

The time spent on games consoles changed relatively little. It increased slightly from 1 hour in 2012 to 1.3 hours in 2021, before returning to 1.1 hours in the final year, exactly the same as the figure for television.

chart.title: Average daily screen time, children aged 8–12

writing.title: Electricity generation by source
writing.prompt:
The line graph below shows the amount of electricity generated from four different sources in one country between 2000 and 2025.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.
outline: Mở bài: paraphrase (lượng điện từ 4 nguồn, 2000–2025)
Tổng quan: than mất vị trí dẫn đầu; gió & mặt trời tăng nhanh thành nguồn lớn nhất; khí đốt tăng; thuỷ điện gần như không đổi
Thân 2: gió & mặt trời 2 → 65 → 110, vượt cả than và khí; thuỷ điện 30–35
vocab: Coal was the dominant source in 2000.
writing.sample:
The line graph compares the quantity of electricity produced from coal, natural gas, hydropower, and wind and solar power in one country over a 25-year period starting in 2000.

Overall, coal lost its position as the dominant source, while electricity from wind and solar grew rapidly to become the largest source by the end of the period. Gas also rose considerably, whereas hydropower remained broadly unchanged.

In 2000, coal generated 120 TWh of electricity, far more than any other source. Its output peaked at 140 TWh in 2010 but then fell sharply, dropping to just 60 TWh in 2025. Natural gas followed a different pattern, more than doubling from 40 TWh to a high of 95 TWh in 2020, before easing slightly to 90 TWh.

Wind and solar power contributed only 2 TWh at the start of the period. However, production accelerated after 2010, reaching 65 TWh in 2020 and 110 TWh in 2025, when it overtook both coal and gas. Hydropower, by contrast, fluctuated only marginally, staying between 30 and 35 TWh throughout the period.

writing.title: How people paid for everyday purchases
writing.prompt:
The line graph below shows the percentage of everyday purchases made using cash, bank cards and mobile phone payments in one country from 2014 to 2024.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.
outline: Mở bài: paraphrase (tỉ lệ giao dịch bằng tiền mặt, thẻ, điện thoại, 2014–2024)
Tổng quan: tiền mặt từ phổ biến nhất → ít nhất; thanh toán di động tăng vọt thành phổ biến nhất; thẻ tăng rồi giảm
Thân 1: tiền mặt 62% → 15%, giảm mạnh nhất 2018–2020 (46% → 30%)
vocab: Cash accounted for just 15% of purchases.
There was a steep drop between 2018 and 2020.
Mobile payments became the leading method.
writing.sample:
The line graph shows what proportion of everyday purchases in one country were paid for in cash, by bank card and by mobile phone over the decade from 2014 to 2024.

Overall, cash went from being the most common payment method to the least common, while mobile payments grew dramatically to become the most popular by 2024. Card payments rose and then fell.

In 2014, cash was used for 62% of purchases, compared with 35% for bank cards and only 3% for mobile payments. The share of cash then fell continuously, with a particularly steep drop between 2018 and 2020, from 46% to 30%. By 2024, it accounted for just 15% of purchases.

Bank cards initially gained popularity, almost matching cash in 2018 (45% and 46% respectively) and peaking at half of all purchases in 2020. After that, however, their share declined to 40%. Meanwhile, mobile payments grew slowly at first, reaching only 9% in 2018, but then increased rapidly to 20% in 2020 and 45% in 2024, making them the leading method of payment at the end of the period.

chart.title: Share of everyday purchases by payment method

writing.title: Rent for a one-bedroom flat in three cities
writing.prompt:
The line graph below shows the average monthly rent for a one-bedroom flat in three cities between 2016 and 2024.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.
outline: Mở bài: paraphrase (tiền thuê căn hộ 1 phòng ngủ ở 3 thành phố, 2016–2024)
Tổng quan: cả 3 đều tăng; Northport tăng mạnh nhất, thay Lakeside thành đắt nhất; Riverton rẻ nhất suốt giai đoạn
Thân 1: số liệu 2016 (Lakeside 1,200 > Northport 900 > Riverton 700); Lakeside tăng nhẹ, giảm năm 2020, phục hồi về 1,250
Thân 2: Northport giảm nhẹ 2018–2020 rồi tăng vọt lên 1,600 (+700); Riverton tăng đều, kết thúc ở 950
vocab: There was a small dip between 2018 and 2020.
writing.sample:
The line graph illustrates changes in the average monthly cost of renting a one-bedroom flat in Northport, Riverton and Lakeside over an eight-year period from 2016.

Overall, rents rose in all three cities, but the increase was by far the largest in Northport, which replaced Lakeside as the most expensive city. Riverton remained the cheapest throughout.

In 2016, Lakeside had the highest rents, at $1,200 a month, compared with $900 in Northport and $700 in Riverton. Rents in Lakeside then rose slightly to $1,250 in 2018 before falling to $1,100 in 2020, and they recovered only gradually afterwards, returning to $1,250 in 2024.

Northport saw the most dramatic change. After a small dip from $1,050 to $1,000 between 2018 and 2020, rents there surged to $1,300 in 2022, overtaking Lakeside, and reached $1,600 by the end of the period, an overall increase of $700. In Riverton, by contrast, rents grew steadily but modestly, by $60 to $70 every two years, finishing at $950.

writing.title: Age of parents at the birth of their first child
writing.prompt:
The line graph below shows the average age of mothers and fathers at the birth of their first child, and the average age of women at their first marriage, in one country between 1970 and 2020.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.
outline: Mở bài: paraphrase (tuổi trung bình khi sinh con đầu của mẹ, cha và tuổi kết hôn lần đầu của phụ nữ, 1970–2020)
Tổng quan: cả 3 tăng đều → kết hôn, sinh con muộn hơn; cha luôn lớn tuổi hơn mẹ
Thân 1: mẹ 23.5 → 31, cha 26 → 33.5; chênh lệch khoảng 2.5 năm, gần như không đổi
Thân 2: tuổi kết hôn 22 → 30.4; khoảng cách giữa kết hôn và sinh con đầu thu hẹp (1.5 năm → dưới 1 năm)
vocab: Fathers were consistently older than mothers.
Marriage age followed a similar upward trend.
The difference narrowed slightly over time.
writing.sample:
The line graph shows how the average age at which women and men in one country had their first child changed between 1970 and 2020, together with the average age at which women first married.

Overall, all three figures rose steadily over the 50-year period, meaning that people were marrying and starting families considerably later by 2020. Fathers were consistently older than mothers when their first child was born.

In 1970, women had their first child at an average age of 23.5, while men became fathers at 26. Both figures increased by roughly one to two years each decade, reaching 31 for mothers and 33.5 for fathers in 2020. The gap between the two remained almost constant at about two and a half years throughout.

The average age at which women first married followed a very similar upward trend. It stood at 22 in 1970, one and a half years below the age of first-time mothers, and climbed to 30.4 by 2020. Interestingly, the difference between the age of marriage and that of first motherhood narrowed slightly over time, falling to less than a year by the end of the period.

chart.title: Average age at first birth and first marriage

writing.title: Monthly visitors to a national museum
writing.prompt:
The line graph below shows the number of local and overseas visitors to a national museum in each month of 2024.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.
outline: Mở bài: paraphrase (khách trong nước và nước ngoài đến bảo tàng theo tháng, 2024)
Tổng quan: hai nhóm có mùa cao điểm ngược nhau – khách nước ngoài đông vào mùa hè, khách trong nước đông vào mùa đông
Thân 1: khách trong nước 42 nghìn (T1) → thấp nhất 24 nghìn (T8) → đỉnh 55 nghìn (T12)
Thân 2: khách nước ngoài 15, 14 nghìn → vượt khách trong nước từ T4 → đỉnh 70 nghìn (T8) → 18 nghìn (T11) → 22 nghìn (T12)
vocab: The two groups showed opposite seasonal patterns.
Overseas visitors outnumbered local visitors from April to September.
Overseas visitors followed the reverse trend.
Numbers declined to a low of 24,000.
Local people dominated in the rest of the year.
writing.sample:
The line graph compares the number of visitors from within the country and from overseas who came to a national museum in each month of 2024.

Overall, the two groups showed opposite seasonal patterns: overseas visitors came mainly in the summer months, whereas local visitors were most numerous in winter. Overseas visitors outnumbered local visitors from April to September, while local people dominated in the rest of the year.

The number of local visitors was highest at the beginning and end of the year. It started at 42,000 in January and declined gradually to a low of 24,000 in August. After that, it rose steadily, reaching a peak of 55,000 in December, its highest figure of the year.

Overseas visitors followed the reverse trend. Only 15,000 came in January and 14,000 in February, but numbers rose sharply from March, overtaking local visitors in April and climbing to a peak of 70,000 in August, the highest monthly figure for either group. They then fell rapidly to 18,000 in November, before increasing slightly to 22,000 in December.

writing.title: Bike-share use throughout the day
writing.prompt:
The line graph below shows the average number of bicycles hired per hour from a city's bike-sharing scheme at different times of day on weekdays and at weekends.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.
outline: Mở bài: paraphrase (số xe đạp được thuê mỗi giờ từ 6h đến 22h, ngày thường và cuối tuần)
Tổng quan: ngày thường có 2 đỉnh nhọn vào giờ đi làm/tan làm; cuối tuần tăng dần đến 1 đỉnh duy nhất đầu giờ chiều
Thân 1: ngày thường 300 → 2,400 (8h) → 800–1,300 giữa ngày → đỉnh 2,600 (18h) → 400 (22h)
Thân 2: cuối tuần 100 → đỉnh 2,100 (14h), cao hơn ngày thường từ 10h đến 16h → 800 → 500
vocab: The peaks coincide with commuting times.
A second peak was recorded at 6pm.
Weekend use exceeded weekday use from 10am to 4pm.
Weekend use rose to a single peak.
writing.sample:
The line graph compares the average number of bicycles hired per hour from a city bike-sharing scheme between 6am and 10pm on weekdays and at weekends.

Overall, weekday hiring was dominated by two sharp peaks in the morning and early evening, which coincide with commuting times, whereas weekend use rose gradually to a single peak in the early afternoon.

On weekdays, only 300 bicycles an hour were hired at 6am, but the figure jumped to 2,400 at 8am. Demand then fell to 900 at 10am and remained between 800 and 1,300 for most of the day. A second, slightly higher peak of 2,600 was recorded at 6pm, after which use dropped steadily to 400 by 10pm.

At weekends, the pattern was very different. Hiring began at just 100 bicycles an hour at 6am and climbed steadily throughout the morning, reaching a high of 2,100 at 2pm. Weekend use was higher than weekday use from 10am to 4pm. After its peak, it declined gradually to 800 at 8pm and 500 at 10pm, slightly above the weekday figure of 400.

writing.title: Sales of printed books, e-books and audiobooks
writing.prompt:
The line graph below shows sales of printed books, e-books and audiobooks in one country between 2010 and 2024.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.
outline: Mở bài: paraphrase (doanh số sách in, sách điện tử, sách nói, 2010–2024)
Tổng quan: sách in luôn bán chạy nhất dù giảm lúc đầu; e-book tăng nhanh rồi giảm; sách nói tăng đều, đứng thứ hai cuối kỳ
Thân 1: sách in 180 → 150 (2016) → ổn định 148–155 triệu
Thân 2: e-book 10 → 60 (2014) → giảm, 60 (2020) → 45; sách nói 2 → 26 (2020) → 50, vượt e-book
vocab: Printed books remained the best-selling format.
E-book sales soared from 10 to 60 million.
từ mức xuất phát rất thấp
Audiobooks started from a very low base.
writing.sample:
The line graph shows the number of printed books, e-books and audiobooks sold in one country from 2010 to 2024.

Overall, printed books remained by far the best-selling format throughout the period despite an initial decline. E-book sales rose quickly and then fell back, while audiobooks grew steadily to become the second most popular format by the end of the period.

Sales of printed books stood at 180 million copies in 2010 but fell to 150 million by 2016. After that, they stabilised, fluctuating between 148 and 155 million copies for the rest of the period.

E-books were the fastest-growing format at first, with sales soaring from 10 million to 60 million between 2010 and 2014. However, this growth was not sustained: sales dipped slightly over the next four years, recovered briefly to 60 million in 2020 and then fell to 45 million in 2024. Audiobooks, by contrast, started from a very low base of just 2 million copies, but their sales accelerated after 2016, climbing to 26 million in 2020 and 50 million in 2024, when they overtook e-books.

writing.title: Unemployment rates by age group
writing.prompt:
The line graph below shows unemployment rates among three age groups in one country between 2008 and 2024.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.
outline: Mở bài: paraphrase (tỉ lệ thất nghiệp của 3 nhóm tuổi, 2008–2024)
Tổng quan: nhóm 16–24 luôn cao hơn hẳn; cả 3 nhóm tăng vào 2010–2012 và 2020, nhưng nhóm trẻ dao động mạnh nhất
vocab: Young people had a much higher unemployment rate.
The fluctuations were more pronounced for the youngest group.
The figure fell steadily back to 12%.
It dropped to its lowest level in 2024.
kết thúc giai đoạn ở mức
Both rates finished the period at 4%.
writing.sample:
The line graph illustrates the percentage of people aged 16–24, 25–49 and 50–64 who were unemployed in one country over the period from 2008 to 2024.

Overall, young people aged 16 to 24 had a much higher unemployment rate than the two older groups throughout the period. All three groups followed a similar pattern, with rises in 2010–2012 and in 2020, but the fluctuations were far more pronounced for the youngest group.

In 2008, 12% of those aged 16 to 24 were unemployed. This figure rose sharply to a peak of 21% in 2012, then fell steadily back to 12% in 2018. After a second increase to 18% in 2020, it dropped to 11% in 2024, its lowest level in the period.

The rates for the two older groups were much lower and more stable. Unemployment among 25- to 49-year-olds rose from 5% to 9% between 2008 and 2012, while the figure for those aged 50 to 64 increased from 4% to 7%. Both rates then declined, rose again slightly in 2020 and finished the period at 4%.

writing.title: Household ownership of digital devices
writing.prompt:
The bar chart below shows the percentage of households in one country that owned five types of digital device in 2009 and 2024.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.
outline: Mở bài: paraphrase (tỉ lệ hộ gia đình sở hữu 5 loại thiết bị số, 2009 và 2024)
Tổng quan: mọi thiết bị đều tăng trừ máy tính bàn; laptop thay máy tính bàn thành thiết bị phổ biến nhất
Thân 1 (2009): máy tính bàn 72%, laptop 45%, smart TV 8%, tablet và loa thông minh 0%
Thân 2 (2024): laptop 86% (gần gấp đôi), máy tính bàn 28%; smart TV 79% (gần gấp 10); tablet 64%; loa thông minh 41%
vocab: Desktops were well ahead of laptops in 2009.
Smart TV ownership rose almost tenfold.
Smart speakers were not yet widely available.
writing.sample:
The bar chart compares the proportion of households in one country that owned a desktop computer, a laptop, a tablet, a smart TV and a smart speaker in 2009 and 2024.

Overall, ownership of every device except the desktop computer increased considerably over the 15-year period, and laptops replaced desktops as the most commonly owned device.

In 2009, desktop computers were found in 72% of homes, well ahead of laptops, which were owned by 45% of households. Smart TVs were rare, at only 8%, and none of the households surveyed owned a tablet or a smart speaker, as these products were not yet widely available.

By 2024, the situation had changed dramatically. Laptop ownership had almost doubled to 86%, while the figure for desktop computers had fallen to just 28%. Smart TVs showed the largest increase, rising almost tenfold to 79%. Tablets, which had been absent in 2009, were present in 64% of homes, and 41% of households had a smart speaker.

writing.title: Time spent on housework by men and women
writing.prompt:
The bar chart below shows the average number of hours per week that men and women in different age groups spent on household chores in one country in 2024.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.
outline: Mở bài: paraphrase (số giờ làm việc nhà mỗi tuần của nam và nữ theo 6 nhóm tuổi, 2024)
Tổng quan: nữ làm nhiều hơn ở mọi nhóm tuổi; nam tăng dần theo tuổi, nữ đạt đỉnh ở nhóm 35–44
Thân 1: 18–24 chênh lệch nhỏ (8 vs 5 giờ); khoảng cách nới rộng; 35–44 nữ 24 giờ, gấp đôi nam (12 giờ)
Thân 2: nữ giảm dần còn 20 rồi 18 giờ; nam ổn định 11–12 giờ rồi tăng lên 14 giờ; khoảng cách hẹp nhất ở hai đầu
vocab: Women spent more time on household chores.
The gap widened in the next two age groups.
Women did twice as much housework as men.
The gap was narrowest at both ends of the age range.
writing.sample:
The bar chart illustrates how many hours a week men and women in six age groups spent doing household chores in one country in 2024.

Overall, women did more housework than men in every age group. The amount of time men spent on chores generally increased with age, while for women it peaked in the 35–44 age group.

Among the youngest adults, those aged 18 to 24, the difference between the sexes was relatively small: women spent 8 hours a week on chores, compared with 5 hours for men. However, the gap widened considerably in the next two age groups. Women aged 35 to 44 did 24 hours of housework a week, twice as much as men of the same age, who did 12 hours.

After this point, the figures for women declined gradually, to 20 hours for those aged 45 to 54 and 18 hours for those aged 65 and over. Men's contribution, by contrast, remained fairly stable at 11 to 12 hours in middle age before rising to 14 hours among the oldest group. As a result, the gap between the sexes was narrowest at the two ends of the age range.

writing.title: How people travelled to work in a city
writing.prompt:
The bar chart below shows the percentage of workers in one city who used different methods of transport to travel to work in 2000 and 2020.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.
outline: Mở bài: paraphrase (phương tiện đi làm ở một thành phố, 2000 và 2020)
Tổng quan: ô tô vẫn phổ biến nhất nhưng giảm mạnh; metro xuất hiện và đứng thứ hai năm 2020; xe đạp tăng
Thân 1 (2000): ô tô 48%, xe buýt 27%, đi bộ 15%, xe đạp 6%, khác 4%, chưa có metro
Thân 2 (2020): ô tô 34%, metro 22%, xe buýt 18%, xe đạp 14% (hơn gấp đôi), đi bộ 9%, khác 3%
vocab: The most notable change was the arrival of the metro.
4% of people used other means of transport.
writing.sample:
The bar chart compares the methods of transport that workers in one city used to get to work in 2000 and 2020.

Overall, the car remained the most common way of commuting in both years, but its share fell significantly. The most notable changes were the arrival of the metro, which became the second most popular option by 2020, and the growth in cycling.

In 2000, almost half of all workers (48%) drove to work, while 27% travelled by bus and 15% walked. Cycling accounted for only 6% of journeys, and 4% of people used other means of transport. There was no metro in the city at that time.

Twenty years later, the proportion of people commuting by car had dropped to 34%, and bus use had also fallen, to 18%. The metro, by contrast, was used by 22% of workers. Cycling more than doubled, rising to 14%, whereas the share of people walking to work declined to 9%, and other methods remained marginal at 3%.

chart.title: Main method of travelling to work

writing.title: Recycling by type of material
writing.prompt:
The bar chart below shows the amount of different types of household waste that were recycled in one city in 2014 and 2024.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.
outline: Mở bài: paraphrase (lượng rác thải sinh hoạt được tái chế theo loại, 2014 và 2024)
Tổng quan: tổng lượng tái chế tăng mạnh, nhiều nhất ở rác thực phẩm và nhựa; giấy nhiều nhất cả hai năm nhưng là loại duy nhất giảm
Thân 1 (2014): giấy 62 nghìn tấn – nhiều hơn tổng 4 loại còn lại; thuỷ tinh 28, nhựa 15, kim loại 12, thực phẩm 5
Thân 2 (2024): thực phẩm 46 (hơn 9 lần), nhựa 38 (hơn gấp đôi), kim loại 18, thuỷ tinh 30; giấy giảm còn 55
vocab: Paper exceeded the other four materials combined.
đứng thứ hai nhưng cách rất xa
Food waste recycling increased more than ninefold.
Food waste became the second largest category.
Metal and glass increased more modestly.
writing.sample:
The bar chart illustrates how many thousand tonnes of five types of household waste were recycled in a city in 2014 and 2024.

Overall, the total amount of waste recycled rose considerably over the decade, with the largest increases in food waste and plastic. Paper was the most recycled material in both years, although it was the only category to decline.

In 2014, 62,000 tonnes of paper were recycled, more than the other four materials combined. Glass was a distant second, at 28,000 tonnes, followed by plastic (15,000 tonnes) and metal (12,000 tonnes). Very little food waste was recycled, only 5,000 tonnes.

By 2024, the picture had changed significantly. The amount of recycled food waste had increased more than ninefold to 46,000 tonnes, making it the second largest category. Plastic recycling also rose sharply, more than doubling to 38,000 tonnes, while the figures for glass and metal increased more modestly, to 30,000 and 18,000 tonnes respectively. In contrast, paper recycling fell slightly to 55,000 tonnes.

writing.title: Visitors to tourist attractions in summer and winter
writing.prompt:
The bar chart below shows the number of visitors to five types of tourist attraction in one region during the summer and winter of 2024.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.
outline: Mở bài: paraphrase (số khách đến 5 loại điểm du lịch, mùa hè và mùa đông 2024)
Tổng quan: phần lớn điểm đến đông hơn vào mùa hè, bãi biển đông nhất cả năm; bảo tàng và khu trượt tuyết đông hơn vào mùa đông
Thân 1 (hè): biển 850, công viên giải trí 520, vườn quốc gia 410, bảo tàng 180, khu trượt tuyết 30 (nghìn lượt)
Thân 2 (đông): trượt tuyết 640 (gấp hơn 20 lần), bảo tàng 260; biển 60, công viên giải trí 210, vườn quốc gia 120
vocab: Beaches were the most popular destination.
In winter, the pattern was almost reversed.
The winter figure was more than twenty times the summer figure.
Ski resorts attracted only 30,000 people in summer.
writing.sample:
The bar chart compares the number of people who visited beaches, theme parks, museums, national parks and ski resorts in one region in the summer and winter of 2024.

Thân 2 (chế biến): tuốt lúa → phơi/sấy → xay bỏ trấu (gạo lứt; trấu làm chất đốt) → xát bỏ cám (gạo trắng; cám làm thức ăn chăn nuôi) → phân loại, đóng gói, đưa đến cửa hàng

The diagram illustrates the process by which white rice is produced, from the preparation of seeds to the packaging of the final product.

Overall, there are ten main stages in the process, which can be divided into two phases: the growing of rice plants in the field and the processing of the harvested grain at a mill. Two by-products, husks and bran, are also created.

The process begins when rice seeds are soaked in water for one to two days and then sown in a nursery bed. After three to four weeks, the young seedlings are transplanted into a flooded field, where they grow for around three to four months. When the rice is ripe, the field is drained and the crop is harvested.

Next, the harvested rice is threshed to separate the grains from the stalks, after which the grains are dried, either in the sun or in dryers. They are then milled to remove the outer husks, producing brown rice, and the husks are used as fuel. In the following stage, the brown rice is polished to remove the bran, which is used as animal feed, leaving white rice. Finally, the rice is sorted, packed and sent to shops.

Tổng quan: 8 bước, bắt đầu bằng thu gom dầu thải, kết thúc bằng việc dùng làm nhiên liệu cho xe buýt, xe tải; phụ phẩm glycerine dùng làm xà phòng
Thân 1: thu gom → lọc cặn thức ăn → đun 100°C để loại nước → trộn methanol và chất xúc tác trong bể phản ứng (60°C, 2 giờ)
Thân 2: bể lắng 8 giờ tách 2 lớp (biodiesel nổi trên, glycerine chìm dưới) → glycerine bán cho nhà sản xuất xà phòng; biodiesel rửa, sấy khô → lưu trữ, pha với diesel thường → dùng cho xe

The oil is taken to a processing plant.
The oil is mixed with methanol and a catalyst.
The mixture is left in a settling tank.
Biodiesel is blended with ordinary diesel.
writing.sample:
The diagram illustrates the process of converting used cooking oil into biodiesel, a fuel that can be used in vehicles.

Overall, the process consists of eight stages, beginning with the collection of waste oil and ending with the use of biodiesel in buses and lorries. Glycerine, which is used to make soap, is produced as a by-product.

First, used cooking oil is collected from restaurants and homes and taken to a processing plant, where it is filtered to remove pieces of food. The oil is then heated to 100°C in order to remove any water. After that, it is pumped into a reactor and mixed with methanol and a catalyst at a temperature of 60°C for two hours.

Following this reaction, the mixture is transferred to a settling tank and left for eight hours, during which time it separates into two layers: biodiesel at the top and glycerine at the bottom. The glycerine is drained off and sent to soap manufacturers, while the biodiesel is washed with water and dried. Finally, it is stored and blended with ordinary diesel before being used to power buses and lorries.

Overall, the cycle consists of six main stages, beginning and ending on the beach where the turtle hatched, and it takes several decades to complete, as turtles only become adults after 20 to 30 years.

Once the eggs hatch, the young turtles dig their way out, usually at night, and crawl down to the sea. They then spend several years drifting in ocean currents. Finally, after reaching maturity at the age of 20 to 30, the adults migrate back to their home beach, where the females lay their own eggs and the cycle begins again.

When fermentation is complete, the liquid is drained from a tap at the bottom of each barrel; this first pressing produces the highest-quality sauce. The remaining fish residue is removed and used as animal feed or fertiliser. Next, the sauce is filtered to remove any fish particles and aged in clay jars in the sun before being bottled. Finally, the bottles are labelled and distributed to shops and restaurants.

Overall, the process has seven stages and divides into two routes after testing: phones that still work are refurbished and resold, while broken phones are taken apart so that their materials can be recovered.

First, old phones are handed in at shops and drop-off boxes. They are then tested and sorted, and any personal data is wiped. Phones that are still working are repaired, cleaned and sold again as second-hand devices.

Thân 1: mặt nước biển > 26.5°C → không khí nóng ẩm bốc lên → hơi nước ngưng tụ thành mây cao, toả nhiệt → áp suất bề mặt giảm, hút thêm không khí vào

The diagram illustrates the natural process by which a typhoon forms over the ocean and eventually reaches land.

Overall, there are six stages in the formation of a typhoon, starting with the heating of the sea by the sun and ending when the storm hits the coast and weakens over land.

The process begins when the sun heats the surface of the sea to a temperature above 26.5°C. Warm, moist air then rises from the ocean, and as it rises, the water vapour it contains condenses into tall clouds, releasing heat. This causes the air pressure at the surface to fall, so more air is drawn in towards the centre of the system.

As this continues, the Earth's rotation makes the storm begin to spin, and an eye forms in the middle. Finally, the typhoon makes landfall, and strong winds and heavy rain hit the coastline. Once it moves over land, however, the storm is cut off from its supply of warm ocean water and gradually weakens.

The floor plans show the ground floor of a public library in 2010 and 2025.

Overall, the library was redesigned to provide more space for children, socialising and creative activities, while the area devoted to books was reduced. The entrance and the toilets stayed in the same place.

In 2010, visitors entered through the main door at the front, where there was a reception desk. To the left of the entrance was an area for newspapers and magazines, and the toilets were on the right. The centre of the floor was taken up by bookshelves, with study tables and a small children's corner to the left, while a computer room and a reference section occupied the right-hand side.

By 2025, the reception desk had been replaced by a smaller help desk and self-service machines, and the newspaper area had been turned into a café. The children's corner had been expanded, and the study tables had become a reading lounge. The bookshelves took up much less space, with an exhibition space beside them. Finally, the computer room had been converted into a maker space with 3D printers, and the reference section had been divided into four study rooms.
writing.imageAlt: Hai sơ đồ tầng trệt thư viện (2010 và 2025). Entrance ở giữa cạnh dưới, Toilets ở góc phải phía trước. Năm 2010: Reception gần lối vào; bên trái lối vào là Newspapers & magazines; giữa là Bookshelves lớn; bên trái phía trên là Children's corner nhỏ, dưới đó là Study tables; bên phải là Computer room (trên) và Reference books (dưới). Năm 2025: Reception → Help desk nhỏ + Self-service machines; Newspapers & magazines → Café; Children's area mở rộng; Study tables → Reading lounge; Bookshelves thu nhỏ, cạnh đó có Exhibition space; Computer room → Maker space (3D printers); Reference books → 4 Study rooms; Toilets giữ nguyên.
